turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so you have twenty minutes to explain why my son found out about a zero from his phone in the middle of class.
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
Nineteen minutes. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone hear Owen out before it went in?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.

That's a percentage from software, not evidence, and your own procedure, section 4.3, says it can't establish anything on its own. I have the vendor's guidance in my bag saying the same thing, so what else do you have?
That's very high. The software is quite reliable.

"Quite reliable." Fourteen of those tools were tested in 2023 and the researchers called them neither accurate nor reliable, so I'm writing down that this is your basis. Is there anything Owen actually wrote that you can put in front of me, or am I going upstairs?
So I had to give him a zero.

"Had to." Nobody called me before that mark went in, which is section 4.2, so you decided first and skipped the steps your own school wrote down. I'm writing that down, and unless you show me something real in the next minute, the principal is my next stop.
I hope you understand my position.
Don't manage me, Hale. Withdraw the zero today, put an apology to Owen in writing, and keep that mark off every record this school holds.
